verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs explicitly cover issue triage lifecycle (states-triage doc), ownership/assignment rules, and bulk mutation APIs for resolving/ignoring issues, which are core, well-known Sentry features including automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression. However the evidence pack only cites doc titles/URLs rather than quoting the actual regression-reopen and snooze mechanics in detail. Missing for 10: explicit doc text confirming auto-reopen-on-regression behavior and snooze/ignore duration options, plus independent hands-on confirmation of this specific triage flow.
